test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "to."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition that commonly follows **"traveling"** is** "to."**

 
 
• **Example**: *She loves **traveling to**__ exotic places.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct paragraph**: 

Tourists Travelling __**to**__ Jammu and Kashmir have another attraction – a floating post office on the Dal Lake in Srinagar, the first in the country. Floating Post Office, Dal Lake – claimed to be the only one such post office in the world – is ______ (2) ______ on an intricately carved maroon houseboat, fastened on the western edge of the Dal Lake
